what: A blurred (5px) 100:44 ellipse cursor follows the mouse in .4s, when it is over a target it appears in .4s while a teal border is drawn in one stroke (stroke-dashoffset 25vw → 0) and the center arrow (→) line is drawn from the center outward (scaleX 0 → 1) — both .8s cubic-bezier(.85,0,.15,1). On leave the line retracts at once and the ellipse fades out in .4s. Absent at widths of 835 and below and on touch devices

options.size: Cursor width — a number is px, with a unit it is used as is, default 9.375vw
options.narrow: Turned off at this width (px) or below, default 835
options.--fx-ink: Line color (set via style on the cursor), default --kf-accent
options.--fx-blur · --fx-dur · --fx-ease · --fx-: Blur · draw length · curve · border dash length (longer than the ellipse circumference) · arrowhead size · line thickness
options.show: If ”none”, this element does not turn on the cursor and only creates a hidden cursor that follows the mouse — put it on body for pages with no targets, where a hidden cursor should still follow like the original

note: Only one cursor is created at the end of body no matter how many targets there are, and it is removed when all targets are gone. The size and follow of the last-attached target’s options apply to the single cursor.

from.where: news.html .al-news__row a · works.html .al-disc__thumb a · index.html·about.html body (show: none — stays hidden while following)
